body_sections.Summary: Zoetis Australia Research and Manufacturing Pty Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Zoetis Inc. ( Zoetis ), proposes to acquire Betrola Investments Pty Ltd, including its wholly owned subsidiary, Jurox Pty Ltd ( Jurox ) (the Proposed Acquisition ). Zoetis and Jurox both operate globally. In Australia, they are involved in the development, manufacture and marketing of animal health products for companion animals and livestock. The ACCC commenced its public review of the Proposed Acquisition on 30 September 2021. On 17 February 2022, the ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns in relation to the Proposed Acquisition. On 11 August 2022, the ACCC commenced market consultation on a draft proposed section 87B undertaking. On 15 September 2022, the ACCC decided to not oppose Zoetis' proposed acquisition of Jurox, subject to the ACCC accepting a court-enforceable undertaking from Zoetis to divest Jurox's teat sealant and intramammary antibiotic products.
